newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 20,600 MT were 49 percent above the week earlier, but 68 percent below the four-week average. The primary buyers were Mexico (8,800 MT, of which 8,100 MT was rough), the Netherlands (7,900 MT), South Africa (3,000 MT), and the Dominican Republic (1,400 MT).

In addition, net sales reductions of 3,400 MT for Turkey (including net reductions of 18,400 MT of rough rice and increases of 15,000 MT of milled rice) and reductions of 300 MT of rough rice for Guatemala were reported.

Exports of 71,400 MT slipped nine percent from the previous week, but improved 39 percent from the four-week average. Turkey (17,800 MT), Mexico (16,500 MT), the Netherlands (15,300 MT), and Japan (11,000 MT) were the major destinations.
